findings.title: updateMany with empty data throws / never bumps updatedAt
findings.body: CalendarService.ts calls SelectedCalendarRepository.updateManyByCredentialId(this.credential.id, {}) with an empty data object. Prisma rejects updateMany when data is empty (Argument `data` must not be empty), so fetchAvailabilityAndSetCache will throw after it just wrote the cache, breaking watch/subscribe flow. Even if accepted, an empty update does not explicitly set updatedAt, so the intended 'touch SelectedCalendar.updatedAt' does not happen. Pass an explicit timestamp e.g. { updatedAt: new Date() } or remove the call.

findings.title: Delete-cache success never refreshes cache status
findings.body: CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx defines deleteCacheMutation with only showToast + onSuccess callback, while the disconnectMutation in the same file invalidates viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars and viewer.apps.integrations onSettled. After deleting calendarCache rows the connectedCalendars query still holds the old cacheUpdatedAt, so the dropdown continues to show stale Last updated and Delete option until a full reload. Invalidate connectedCalendars after deleteCache settles.

findings.title: Cache status ignores expiry, shows dead cache as active
findings.body: calendar-cache.repository.ts getCacheStatusByCredentialIds groups by credentialId with no expiresAt filter, while getCachedAvailability in the same file only returns rows with expiresAt >= now. Expired rows therefore still produce a max(updatedAt) that the UI renders as Cache Status / Last updated, misleading users into thinking live cache exists and offering delete for inert data. Add expiresAt: { gte: new Date() } to the status query.

findings.title: Throws generic Error instead of TRPCError for auth failure
findings.body: deleteCache.handler.ts throws new Error("Credential not found or access denied") when the credential is not owned by ctx.user. A generic Error surfaces as INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR instead of NOT_FOUND/FORBIDDEN, conflates missing vs forbidden, and breaks client error handling conventions used by other routers that throw TRPCError with a code. Use TRPCError with code NOT_FOUND or FORBIDDEN.

findings.title: Cache timestamp hardcodes en-US locale
findings.body: CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx formats cacheUpdatedAt with new Intl.DateTimeFormat("en-US", ...) even though the component already has useLocale/t(). Users in other locales see US short date/time format inconsistent with the rest of the app. Use the active locale from useLocale instead of a hardcoded string.

findings.title: macOS-only sed breaks script on Linux
findings.body: scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh runs sed -i '' -E to rewrite GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL. The empty backup-suffix argument is BSD/macOS syntax; on GNU/Linux sed it is parsed as an input file and fails, so the helper cannot update .env on Linux dev machines/CI. Detect OS or use a portable sed invocation.
